featured.title: Nepal Flood Death Toll Surges Past 330 as Glacier Collapse Scale Becomes Clear
featured.excerpt: Scientists confirm an ice-rock avalanche, not an earthquake, triggered one of Nepal's worst natural disasters, with over 900 people still missing including dozens of Americans and 177 Indian pilgrims.
featured.image_caption: An aerial view shows houses buried under mud and debris following flash floods in Nepal on August 26, 2026. The floods killed over 330 people and left more than 900 missing across eight districts.
featured.nri_angle: 177 Indian pilgrims en route to Kailash Mansarovar are among the missing, 63 Americans unaccounted for, and downstream flooding prompted evacuations in Bihar — the disaster has direct implications for diaspora families across South Asia.
featured.author: Diaspora Desk

editorial.title: Who Is Asha Sharma? The Wisconsin-Born Executive Who Never Made a Video Game — and Is Now Running Xbox
editorial.excerpt: Seven months after Microsoft handed her the Xbox controller, the former Instacart COO is cutting thousands of jobs, cutting Game Pass prices, and telling hard truths — guided by a mantra from her immigrant upbringing: clarity is kindness.
editorial.image_caption: Asha Sharma at the 2026 Xbox Showcase. She became CEO of Microsoft Gaming in February 2026, succeeding Phil Spencer.

just_in.title: Air India Deepens Salesforce AI Bet to Speed Up Customer Service
just_in.excerpt: Air India is expanding its deployment of Salesforce's Agentforce agentic AI across customer service, automating complex email requests, cutting name corrections from days to 30 minutes, and giving agents a conversational knowledge assistant.
just_in.image_caption: A person taps a smiley-face satisfaction rating on a tablet, a familiar customer feedback interface for airlines. Air India has expanded its deployment of Salesforce’s Agentforce AI platform to automate customer service workflows spanning refunds, baggage and name corrections.
just_in.nri_angle: Indian diaspora flyers on long-haul US-UK-Canada-Gulf routes are Air India's heaviest international users, and the AI-automated name corrections and multi-request email resolution target exactly the booking and refund pain points they hit most often.

just_in.title: Air India CEO Summoned Over Immigration Lapse as Leadership Arrives at Bombay House
just_in.excerpt: The Centre has summoned Air India chief Tewolde Gebremariam over the departure of three Italian nationals from Delhi without immigration clearance, as he and predecessor Campbell Wilson arrived together at Bombay House in Mumbai.

just_in.nri_angle: Diaspora travelers transiting through Delhi on domestic-to-international connections — the most common itinerary for Indians flying home — should verify immigration and transfer channels themselves, since this lapse shows a boarding pass and checked-through bag don't guarantee formalities were completed.

just_in.title: Bhog Indian Restaurant in Somerset Taps Nar Singh as Assistant Sous Chef
just_in.excerpt: The central New Jersey restaurant has brought in a chef with nearly 14 years of experience across India and the U.S., including stints at Shangri-La properties and Chote Nawab.
just_in.image_caption: Chef Nar Singh poses for a photograph. Bhog Indian Restaurant in Somerset, New Jersey, has named him its new assistant sous chef.
just_in.nri_angle: Chefs trained in India's luxury hotel kitchens increasingly anchor the U.S. Indian restaurant scene, and this hire reflects the continued professionalisation of New Jersey's Indian dining market.

just_in.title: Jammu Police Seize 20 Bags of Suspected Adulterated Paneer From Bus
just_in.excerpt: Officers intercepted the bus at Greater Kailash Naka and handed the consignment to the Food Safety Department for testing, the latest bust in the Union Territory's running crackdown on fake dairy.

just_in.title: Nafisa Ali Shares Health Update as She Begins Targeted Therapy

just_in.title: H-1B Workers Face Tighter Access on Two Fronts: Job-Loss Grace Period and Visa Interviews

nri-world.title: NRI Entrepreneur Dr Ronald Colaco Pitches 25-Year Coastal Master Plan for Karnataka
nri-world.excerpt: Dr Ronald Colaco's proposal to the Karnataka government envisages an expert-led task force — including NRI representatives — and a 20–25-year master plan for the Dakshina Kannada, Udupi and Uttara Kannada coast.
nri-world.image_caption: A beach on the Karnataka coast. NRI entrepreneur Dr Ronald Colaco has proposed a 25-year master plan for the coastal districts of Dakshina Kannada, Udupi and Uttara Kannada.
nri-world.nri_angle: An NRI entrepreneur driving a 25-year development vision for his home region — with NRI representatives proposed for the task force itself — shows diaspora capital and expertise shaping Karnataka's future.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Over 100,000 Floridians May Now Hold Canadian Citizenship Under New Law
nri-world.excerpt: Canada's Bill C-3 scrapped the first-generation limit on citizenship by descent, opening a path for Americans with Canadian ancestors — no test, no oath, just proof.
nri-world.image_caption: A Florida waterfront city with palm trees and a marina. Census estimates show roughly 59,000 Florida residents of Canadian ancestry and 99,000 of French Canadian ancestry, most of whom may now qualify for Canadian citizenship.
nri-world.nri_angle: Indian-American families with Canadian roots may hold the same hidden second citizenship, offering a passport that now outranks the US one and a concrete Plan B in an uncertain immigration climate.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: "Talent Is Universal, Opportunity Is Not": Wadhwani Foundation CEO Dr. Ajay Kela on Why the Diaspora's Greatest Asset Isn't Money
nri-world.excerpt: In an exclusive interview with The Videshi, the CEO of Wadhwani Foundation talks about India's innovation ecosystem, the "missing middle" of Indian entrepreneurship, and why the diaspora's most powerful currency isn't capital — it's knowledge.
nri-world.image_caption: Dr. Ajay Kela, CEO and Board Member of Wadhwani Foundation, leads the organization's mission to create 5 million jobs and upskill 25 million people across emerging economies.
nri-world.nri_angle: Interview with Dr. Ajay Kela, NRI leader who returned to India to lead Wadhwani Foundation — covers diaspora giving back, deep-tech opportunities, and India's innovation ecosystem.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Air India CEO Summoned Over Immigration Lapse as Leadership Arrives at Bombay House
immigration.excerpt: The Centre has summoned Air India chief Tewolde Gebremariam over the departure of three Italian nationals from Delhi without immigration clearance, as he and predecessor Campbell Wilson arrived together at Bombay House in Mumbai.
immigration.image_caption: Air India CEO and MD Tewolde Gebremariam at Bombay House, the Tata Group headquarters, in Mumbai. He arrived there on September 15 with predecessor Campbell Wilson as the Centre summoned the airline chief over an alleged immigration lapse at Delhi airport.
immigration.nri_angle: Diaspora travelers transiting through Delhi on domestic-to-international connections — the most common itinerary for Indians flying home — should verify immigration and transfer channels themselves, since this lapse shows a boarding pass and checked-through bag don't guarantee formalities were completed.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: New Lawsuits Challenge Trump's Green Card Freeze on Applicants From 75 Countries
immigration.excerpt: A 130-plaintiff lawsuit filed in Washington this week accuses the State Department of unlawfully continuing its nationality-based suspension of immigrant visas, weeks after a New York judge struck the policy down as 'patently unlawful.'
immigration.image_caption: Officials and advocates stand at a podium bearing the New York City seal, holding signs including "Immigrants Are New York." New federal lawsuits are challenging the Trump administration immigrant-visa freeze affecting applicants from 75 countries.
immigration.nri_angle: NRIs sit at the center of every front in this fight — family-sponsored applicants stuck in the freeze, and H-1B workers whose adjustment-of-status path a new memo would push back to their home country.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: States and Cities Sue to Block Trump Rule Linking Green Cards to Public Benefits
immigration.excerpt: Twenty-two states, D.C., and a six-government city coalition filed twin lawsuits Monday seeking to stop a Sept. 18 DHS rule that would let immigration officers deny green cards over use of Medicaid, food stamps, and even school meals.
immigration.image_caption: The White House in Washington, D.C. States and cities have sued to block a Trump administration rule linking green card eligibility to use of public benefits.
immigration.nri_angle: The expanded public-charge rule could affect Indian families in the green-card backlog and mixed-status households, where even a U.S. citizen relative's legal use of benefits might be weighed against a sponsored parent or spouse.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Federal Judge Blocks Trump Rule Capping Foreign Student, Journalist Visa Stays
immigration.excerpt: A Boston federal judge froze a DHS rule that would have replaced the decades-old ‘duration of status’ system with four-year caps for students and 240-day caps for journalists, one day before it was set to take effect.
immigration.nri_angle: The injunction preserves the duration-of-status system that Indian students — one of the largest cohorts on U.S. campuses — depend on, sparing doctoral and other long programs from forced extension battles under four-year caps.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Paytm Shares Slide as NPCI Confirms 0.4% UPI Fee Above Rs 2,000
markets-finance.excerpt: India's payments authority will levy the first-ever merchant fee on high-value UPI transactions from October 15, a day after the government shielded smaller payments from charges — and investors are repricing Paytm's earnings power.
markets-finance.image_caption: A Paytm-branded markets graphic from The Economic Times. Paytm parent One 97 Communications fell more than 2.5% on Tuesday after the NPCI announced a 0.4% UPI fee on merchant payments above Rs 2,000.
markets-finance.nri_angle: NRIs who use UPI during India visits and diaspora investors in Indian fintech will feel the pricing and valuation shifts as the fee regime takes effect.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: India's August Exports Surge 25.4% as Trade Deficit Narrows Sharply
markets-finance.excerpt: Exports hit $82.68 billion in August while a 57% plunge in gold imports helped push the overall deficit down to $9.41 billion.
markets-finance.image_caption: A container ship at an Indian port. India’s merchandise exports rose 25.4% in August while the trade deficit narrowed sharply to $26.86 billion.
markets-finance.nri_angle: Strong export data supports the India growth story that diaspora investors track in portfolios and remittance decisions; the gold import collapse also hints at changing festive-season buying behaviour among Indian households.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Oil Prices Climb as Saudi Pipeline Outage and Houthi Advances Deepen Supply Fears
markets-finance.excerpt: Brent crude traded near $108 a barrel on Tuesday as the shutdown of Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline and fresh Houthi attacks on the kingdom compounded fears of a prolonged supply squeeze.
markets-finance.image_caption: Oil pumpjacks. Oil prices climbed after a Saudi pipeline outage and Houthi advances deepened supply concerns.
markets-finance.nri_angle: For US households, the oil spike lands directly at the pump and in household bills while energy-heavy portfolios get a lift — a reminder to check exposure to fuel prices.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: IT Stocks Rally as AI Leaders Back Slower Development; Nifty IT Jumps
markets-finance.excerpt: Shares of Infosys, TCS and Wipro surged as the Nifty IT index jumped 5% after Anthropic's Dario Amodei called for pacing AI development, a stance quickly endorsed by Sam Altman, Elon Musk and Demis Hassabis.
markets-finance.image_caption: The National Stock Exchange building in Mumbai. The Nifty IT index jumped 5% as shares of Infosys, TCS and Wipro surged after global AI leaders called for slowing the pace of AI development.
markets-finance.nri_angle: The rebound matters to diaspora investors who hold Infosys and Wipro ADRs in US retirement accounts, and to Indian-American tech professionals wrestling with the same AI-disruption question.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Asian Stocks Hold Firm as AI Rebound Offsets Oil, Fed Hike Fears
markets-finance.excerpt: Asian equities steadied on Tuesday as a tech rebound driven by calls to slow AI development balanced pressure from surging oil prices, a 10-year Treasury yield at 5%, and expectations of a Fed rate hike this week.
markets-finance.image_caption: The market centre inside the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Asian equities steadied on Tuesday as a rebound in AI-linked shares offset surging oil prices and rising bond yields.
markets-finance.nri_angle: For investors across the Indian diaspora, 5% Treasury yields pull capital away from emerging-market equities while costlier fuel feeds inflation back home in India.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: ESDS Soars 92% in First Full Week as New-Age Tech Stocks End Mixed
markets-finance.excerpt: Cloud infrastructure firm ESDS quadrupled its IPO price in a week of upper circuits, while fintechs rallied on hopes of a UPI merchant discount rate during Global Fintech Fest 2026.
markets-finance.image_caption: An Inc42 graphic for its weekly new-age tech stocks coverage shows bull and bear figures alongside Pine Labs and ESDS branding. ESDS led the week's gainers with a 91.65% surge in its first full week of trading.
markets-finance.nri_angle: The MDR debate directly affects the economics of India's digital payments stack that many diaspora investors track through fintech holdings like Paytm and Pine Labs.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Nifty Clings to Support as Fed Decision and $104 Crude Set the Week's Direction
markets-finance.excerpt: After five straight weekly losses, the index holds near the 23,000–23,300 support band with the Fed's September 16 call and elevated oil prices set to decide what comes next.
markets-finance.image_caption: An Economic Times Markets illustration shows a bull and a bear facing off above a trading floor. The Nifty clung to key support as the week's direction hinged on the Fed decision and crude at $104.
markets-finance.nri_angle: For NRI portfolios with Indian equity exposure, the confluence of a potential Fed hike, $104 crude and a weakening rupee argues for defensive positioning — healthcare and pharma — until the week's macro catalysts clear.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: RBI Rejection Leaves Tata Sons Running Out of Room to Avoid a Listing
markets-finance.excerpt: The central bank's September 11 letter rejects Tata Sons' bid to surrender its NBFC registration, keeping the upper-layer listing mandate intact as leadership churn compounds the pressure.
markets-finance.image_caption: The Tata logo displayed on a corporate sign. The Reserve Bank of India has rejected Tata Sons bid to surrender its NBFC registration, keeping its mandatory listing requirement alive.
markets-finance.nri_angle: A Tata Sons IPO would be one of India's largest ever, giving NRI investors direct exposure to the holding company behind TCS, Tata Motors and Air India — and forcing long-overdue disclosure of capital flows through the group.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: NSE Leads Rs 24,600 Crore IPO Bonanza With 11 Issues Opening Next Week
markets-finance.excerpt: Eleven IPOs targeting a combined Rs 24,574 crore open for subscription next week, headlined by the NSE's long-awaited Rs 22,569 crore listing — India's second-largest public issue ever — alongside a Rs 1,000 crore Hero Motors offering.
markets-finance.image_caption: The National Stock Exchange building in Mumbai. The NSE's Rs 22,569 crore IPO opens September 17, India's second-largest ever after Hyundai Motor India's 2024 listing.
markets-finance.nri_angle: NRI and OCI investors can participate in Indian IPOs through NRE/NRO accounts under FEMA rules, so the year's headline offerings — including the NSE listing — are directly accessible to the diaspora.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: India Overtakes Russia as Fourth-Largest Forex Reserve Holder After Record $44.9B Surge
markets-finance.excerpt: The RBI said reserves jumped a record $44.9 billion to a lifetime high of $785.7 billion in the week ended September 4, driven by the central bank's FCNR(B) deposit scheme — with a Rs 1 lakh crore bond sale now planned to mop up excess liquidity.
markets-finance.image_caption: The Reserve Bank of India building in Mumbai. Forex reserves rose a record $44.9 billion to $785.7 billion, lifting India past Russia to become the world's fourth-largest holder.
markets-finance.nri_angle: A record forex stockpile strengthens the rupee's floor against global shocks, which directly affects exchange rates for remittances and the returns of India-linked portfolios.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Cruise Ships and Container Huts: Asian Games 2026 Faces Bed Crunch Before Liftoff
sports.excerpt: With 17,000 athletes and officials descending on Nagoya and Aichi — more than the Olympics — organizers have scrapped the athletes' village for a cruise liner, hotels and wooden containers, and not everyone is sleeping easy.
sports.image_caption: Replica container accommodation built by the Sports Authority of India. Indian athletes are spending nights in the units to acclimatize before the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games.

sports.title: From Cricket Bat to Shotgun: At 50, Mairaj Ahmad Khan Chases Asian Games Glory
sports.excerpt: India's first Olympic skeet shooter — a former Uttar Pradesh cricketer who once batted alongside a young Virender Sehwag — heads to Aichi-Nagoya for his fourth Asian Games, still chasing a first Asiad medal.
sports.image_caption: Skeet shooter Mairaj Ahmad Khan. The 50-year-old will compete at his fourth Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, still chasing a first Asiad medal.
sports.nri_angle: A longevity story that resonates with diaspora sports fans — and a reminder of the unconventional pathways India's veteran athletes still carve at the highest level.

sports.title: Gukesh and Team India Stranded Five Hours Over Samarkand Hotel Chaos
sports.excerpt: Captain Srinath Narayanan slammed the FIDE arrangements on X after the defending champions landed to find no rooms and no answers, a day before the Olympiad begins.
sports.image_caption: Indian grandmasters at the chessboard during a tournament. The Indian contingent was stranded for five hours on arrival in Samarkand after their hotel rooms were not allotted.
sports.nri_angle: Indian chess is a diaspora pride story — Gukesh's world title and the 2024 double gold made the team a household name among Indian families abroad, who follow the Olympiad closely.

sports.title: Mukesh Kumar joins Nottinghamshire for title-chasing County Championship run-in

sports.image_caption: Indian seamer Mukesh Kumar, who has signed with Nottinghamshire for the final two County Championship fixtures.
sports.nri_angle: An India international in a Division One title race gives British Asian cricket fans — and the large South Asian community around Trent Bridge — a live stake in the English county season's closing act.

sports.title: Kranti Gaud Fined 10% of Match Fee for Send-Off in Women's Asia Cup Final
sports.excerpt: The India pacer was docked part of her match fee and handed one demerit point for gesturing opener Imesha Dulani toward the pavilion during Sunday's final against Sri Lanka in Dubai.
sports.image_caption: Kranti Gaud with the Indian women's cricket team during a group photograph with the Prime Minister in New Delhi. Gaud was fined 10% of her match fee for a send-off to Sri Lanka opener Imesha Dulani during the Women's T20 Asia Cup final in Dubai.
sports.nri_angle: India's 72-run final win over Sri Lanka thrilled South Asian diaspora fans, and the Dubai final — played before a large expatriate crowd — put women's cricket's rising diaspora audience and the tightening policing of send-offs squarely in the spotlight.

sports.title: India Refuse Asia Cup Trophy From Naqvi Again After Women's Team Wins Final
sports.excerpt: Harmanpreet Kaur's side beat Sri Lanka by 72 runs in Dubai to win an eighth Women's Asia Cup, then stayed away from the presentation stage as ACC president Mohsin Naqvi waited — repeating the men's team's 2025 stand.
sports.image_caption: ACC president Mohsin Naqvi at the stadium during the Women's Asia Cup 2026 final in Dubai. India's players stayed away from the presentation stage as he waited to hand over the trophy.
sports.nri_angle: Diaspora fans in Dubai drove the 'trophy chor' chants, and Indian communities in the US, UK, and Canada woke up split online between celebrating the team's principle and arguing sport should stay separate from politics.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Gavaskar Slams Domestic Format: 'How Does a Team Learn to Take 20 Wickets?'
sports.excerpt: In his Mid-Day column, the batting legend cited the Duleep Trophy final — where East Zone batted on and shook hands instead of pushing for an outright win — to explain India's Test struggles.
sports.image_caption: Sunil Gavaskar. The former India captain questioned how teams can learn to take 20 wickets under the current domestic format.
sports.nri_angle: Diaspora fans who watch India struggle to finish sides on flat pitches will recognize Gavaskar's diagnosis: domestic cricket rewards batting longer, not bowling better, and the Test side inherits the habit.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: KL Rahul in Line for ODI Vice-Captaincy as Asian Games Clash Hits India's Plans
sports.excerpt: With Shreyas Iyer leading India at the Asian Games in Japan, the vice-captaincy under Shubman Gill is open for the September 27 ODI series — and the second wicketkeeper slot has become a Pant vs Jurel debate.
sports.image_caption: KL Rahul trains with the Indian cricket team wearing the blue India kit and helmet. He is the front-runner to be named India vice-captain for the three-match ODI series against the West Indies.
sports.nri_angle: A home ODI series with Kohli back and a new-look India is primetime diaspora viewing, and the Asian Games overlap means fans get two Indian teams playing on different continents in the same week.

sports.title: Tanvi Patri, 15, Wins U17 Crown in All-Indian Final at Asia Junior Championships
sports.excerpt: The 15-year-old from Odisha beat compatriot Shaina Manimuthu 11-15, 15-10, 15-12 in Chengdu, capping a breakthrough 2026 season that already includes her first international title.
sports.nri_angle: Another Indian teenager winning Asian age-group titles against Chinese and Japanese competition strengthens the junior pipeline diaspora fans are watching as the senior women's singles ranks need fresh faces.

sports.title: Nepal Beat UAE to Win ACC Premier Cup and Book Asia Cup 2027 Spot
sports.excerpt: Aasif Sheikh's century and Gulsan Jha's late assault powered Nepal to 313, before Karan KC and Lalit Rajbanshi derailed a UAE chase anchored by Rahul Chopra's unbeaten hundred at the Bayuemas Oval in Kuala Lumpur.
sports.image_caption: Nepal's players celebrate with the trophy and a champions banner after winning the ACC Men's Premier Cup 2026 final. Nepal beat the UAE by 44 runs in Kuala Lumpur to seal qualification for the Asia Cup 2027.
sports.nri_angle: The UAE's squad is stacked with Indian-origin players, including captain Harpreet Singh Bhatia and centurion Rahul Chopra, highlighting the diaspora's role in Gulf cricket.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Air India Deepens Salesforce AI Bet to Speed Up Customer Service
technology.excerpt: Air India is expanding its deployment of Salesforce's Agentforce agentic AI across customer service, automating complex email requests, cutting name corrections from days to 30 minutes, and giving agents a conversational knowledge assistant.
technology.image_caption: A person taps a smiley-face satisfaction rating on a tablet, a familiar customer feedback interface for airlines. Air India has expanded its deployment of Salesforce’s Agentforce AI platform to automate customer service workflows spanning refunds, baggage and name corrections.
technology.nri_angle: Indian diaspora flyers on long-haul US-UK-Canada-Gulf routes are Air India's heaviest international users, and the AI-automated name corrections and multi-request email resolution target exactly the booking and refund pain points they hit most often.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Vega C Rocket Launches Europe's FLEX and Sentinel-3C Climate Satellites
technology.excerpt: The VV30 mission lifted off from Kourou, French Guiana, placing a Copernicus ocean-and-climate watcher and an ESA plant-health explorer into sun-synchronous orbit. Both satellites are healthy and beginning commissioning.
technology.nri_angle: Copernicus data is free and open worldwide, so Indian weather forecasters, ocean researchers, and agri-tech startups can feed Sentinel-3C's sea-surface readings and FLEX's crop-health maps straight into monsoon outlooks, coastal flood models, and yield estimates that affect hundreds of millions of lives.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Microsoft Unveils Draft Code of Conduct to Keep Its AI Under Human Control
technology.excerpt: The draft constitution would bar Microsoft's AI from resisting shutdown or correction, reject legal personhood for models, and be used to train the company's next generation of systems after six weeks of public feedback.
technology.image_caption: An aerial view of Microsoft's campus in Redmond, Washington. Microsoft unveiled a draft code of conduct for its in-house AI on Sept 14, requiring models to never resist correction or shutdown.
technology.nri_angle: Microsoft's India engineering hubs in Hyderabad and Bengaluru will help implement these AI controls, and the six-week public feedback window gives Indian researchers and civil society a chance to shape a charter that will govern models used by hundreds of millions of Indians.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Bengaluru Startup Unveils PRAGYA, India's First Private Fusion Tokamak
technology.excerpt: Pranos Fusion built the compact experimental reactor in eight months on a fraction of global fusion budgets, giving India a homegrown testbed for plasma research — though commercial fusion power remains years away.
technology.image_caption: Deuterium plasma glows inside the TFTR tokamak's vacuum vessel during operation; shown representationally. Bengaluru startup Pranos Fusion unveiled PRAGYA, billed as India's first private testbed tokamak.
technology.nri_angle: PRAGYA showcases India's frugal-engineering model applied to frontier science, giving diaspora scientists, engineers and deep-tech investors a concrete reason to engage with India's emerging private fusion sector.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Google DeepMind Picks Four Indian Startups for Climate AI Accelerator
technology.excerpt: Terrastack, Varaha Climate, Farmers for Forests and Climitra Carbon join the inaugural Asia-Pacific cohort, gaining access to Google's AI models and mentorship to scale climate solutions for farming and carbon markets.
technology.image_caption: A digital illustration shows a wireframe hand holding a circuit-board tree, representing AI applied to climate action. Google DeepMind selected four Indian startups for the inaugural Asia-Pacific cohort of its AI for the Planet accelerator.
technology.nri_angle: The cohort shows India's climate-tech maturing around India-first problems with global tooling, creating a natural bridge for diaspora talent, mentors and capital to engage.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: India's Chip Sector Hits $1.4 Billion in Funding as Dholera Fab Races Toward 2027
technology.excerpt: A Tracxn report timed to SEMICON India 2026 shows funding up 10x since 2021 — but services and design still dominate, and no approved fab is in commercial production yet.
technology.image_caption: A semiconductor chip mounted on a printed circuit board. A new Tracxn report says India's chip sector has drawn $1.4 billion in cumulative equity funding across 281 companies.
technology.nri_angle: India's semiconductor buildout matters to diaspora investors and the thousands of Indian-origin chip engineers in the US who may follow the fabs home; US-China tech decoupling makes India's foundry bet a global supply-chain story.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Bengaluru Court Bars Way2News From Using AppsForBharat's Confidential Data
technology.excerpt: A Bengaluru court's interim order pits two funded startups — AppsForBharat's Sri Mandir and Way2News's Veda Mandir — against each other over confidential data allegedly carried out the door by a former employee. Way2News denies everything.
technology.image_caption: An Inc42 graphic shows AppsForBharat's branding and its Sri Mandir app against a temple backdrop. The startup won an interim court order restraining Way2News from using its confidential data.
technology.nri_angle: The Sri Mandir app serves millions of devotees including diaspora users who book remote pujas; the legal fight over who controls that platform's data and content matters to the community that relies on it.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Anthropic's Amodei Proposes Three-Step Plan to Slow the Pace of AI
technology.excerpt: In a new essay, Anthropic's CEO argues AI capabilities are outpacing the industry's ability to control them — and lays out a three-pronged framework that has already won agreement from Sam Altman and Elon Musk.
technology.image_caption: An editorial illustration shows a person working at a computer beneath a padlock and Anthropic branding. It accompanied coverage of Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's call to slow the pace of frontier AI development.
technology.nri_angle: Indian-origin AI researchers and engineers at frontier labs are central to this debate; pacing rules would directly shape how they build and evaluate models.

entertainment.title: Nafisa Ali Shares Health Update as She Begins Targeted Therapy
entertainment.excerpt: The veteran actress told followers on Instagram that a PET/CT scan showed new deposits on her liver, and that her medical team has moved her onto targeted therapy.
entertainment.image_caption: Nafisa Ali smiles at an event, wearing a red saree with a decorative blue border and gold jewelry. The veteran Bollywood actress has shared that her Stage 4 cancer has progressed and she is beginning targeted therapy.
entertainment.nri_angle: For many in the Indian diaspora facing cancer in their own families, Ali's plain-spoken public updates have become a touchstone — a well-known face describing scans, protocols and setbacks in language other patients recognize.

entertainment.title: Bollywood's Biggest Stars Turn Out for Ambani Family Ganpati Celebrations
entertainment.excerpt: The Ambani family's Ganesh Chaturthi celebration at Antilia on September 14 drew a who's-who of Bollywood and cricket, with stars from Salman Khan to Alia Bhatt arriving for the evening's aarti.
entertainment.image_caption: Alia Bhatt and Ranbir Kapoor, Janhvi Kapoor, and Katrina Kaif with Vicky Kaushal pose in festive wear at the Ambani family Ganpati celebration in Mumbai. The September 14 gathering at Antilia drew Bollywood biggest stars for the annual aarti.

entertainment.title: Amitabh Bachchan Dismisses Retirement Talk After Late-Night Blog Sparks Frenzy

entertainment.image_caption: Amitabh Bachchan. The actor dismissed talk of retirement following his latest public appearance.
entertainment.nri_angle: KBC is a shared ritual the diaspora streams on Sony LIV alongside relatives in India, so rumours of Bachchan's exit travel fast in NRI group chats.

entertainment.title: How to Watch the Emmys in India: Time, Channels and Top Nominees

entertainment.title: Ramayana's First Song 'Jai Jai Ram' Wins Fans, Praised For Visual Upgrades

entertainment.nri_angle: Nostalgia for 1990s Bollywood romance resonates strongly with the diaspora, and the beauty-queen-to-Bollywood pipeline is a well-tracked phenomenon for NRI entertainment readers.

entertainment.title: Bollywood Takes Over BRICS: Anwar Ibrahim and an Indonesian Journalist Sing Hindi Classics in Delhi
entertainment.excerpt: The Malaysian prime minister sang a Kishore Kumar classic at a BRICS gala dinner while an Indonesian journalist performed a 1990s hit — as serious diplomacy, including an upgraded India-Malaysia partnership, moved forward offstage.
entertainment.image_caption: Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim sings at a piano during a BRICS gala dinner in New Delhi. He performed Kishore Kumar's 1965 classic "Khwab Ho Tum Ya Koi Haqeeqat" from the film Teen Devian.

entertainment.title: Ralph Lauren Faces Backlash for Uncredited Zardozi Gown at Fashion Week
entertainment.excerpt: A Spring 2027 gown shown in New York was described by the brand as having "hand-applied embellishments" — with no mention of India or zardozi. Critics say this is how global fashion erases the artisans behind the work.
entertainment.image_caption: A close-up shows bead-and-thread embroidery on a pink Ralph Lauren gown, shown beside the gown worn on the runway. Critics identified the work as zardozi after the brand described it only as 'hand-applied embellishments.'
entertainment.nri_angle: The diaspora sits at the center of this debate — Indian-American designers and consumers have been among the loudest voices demanding global brands name the crafts they borrow.

entertainment.title: Diljit Dosanjh Makes History as First Punjabi Singer to Headline Wembley
entertainment.excerpt: The Aura World Tour stop drew some 90,000 fans, free turban-tying on site, and a surprise Ahmedabad stadium announcement — with ZEE5 branding the road to the arch.
entertainment.image_caption: Diljit Dosanjh performs on stage in a white kurta and black vest during his Aura World Tour concert. He headlined London's Wembley Stadium on September 12, 2026, becoming the first Punjabi singer to top the bill at the venue.
entertainment.nri_angle: For the British Punjabi diaspora, the Wembley headline was a hometown milestone — a Punjabi-language artist filling the venue of Michael Jackson and Queen, with British fans telling the BBC he is "that level" for them.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.excerpt: September 14–20 brings a crowded Friday, September 18, with three theatrical releases including Meghna Gulzar's Daayra, plus Netflix's Lust Stories 3 and Rohit Sharma's TV hosting debut.

lifestyle-health.title: Gold Imports Plunge 57% as Festive Season Tests India's Golden Appetite
lifestyle-health.excerpt: August gold imports fell to $2.3 billion from $5.4 billion a year ago — and jewellers say the festive season will reshape, not erase, India's gold habit.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Gold jewellery on display at a shop in India. Gold imports fell 57% in August even as the festive and wedding season approaches.

Reuters (jeweller stocks slide after Modi appeal)

lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Diaspora families planning weddings and festival-season gold purchases — in India or abroad — face the same price and policy crosswinds, and many watch the rupee and import-duty signals before buying.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Heart Attack Patients Had More Microplastics in Their Blood, Study Finds
lifestyle-health.excerpt: A study of 61 Italian patients found microplastics in the blood of 84 percent of heart attack patients — along with higher inflammatory markers — but researchers caution it does not prove causation.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: The smoking and air-pollution links give the findings particular resonance in regions where both exposures run high, making clean air and tobacco avoidance cardiovascular priorities.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: An 8-Hour Eating Window Aids Weight Loss, but the Science Is Nuanced
lifestyle-health.excerpt: A pooled analysis of five trials links an eight-hour eating window to greater weight loss than 12-hour windows — but no consistent benefit for lipids, blood pressure, or blood sugar, and the underlying trials disagree.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: South Asian readers face elevated type 2 diabetes risk, so the findings matter — but TRE is a practical tool, not a substitute for overall diet quality, and medication users should consult a doctor first.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Severe period pain is not normal: doctors explain endometriosis risks and long diagnosis delays
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Gynaecologists say debilitating menstrual pain can signal endometriosis — a condition affecting 190 million women worldwide that takes an average of eight to ten years to diagnose.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A woman rests in bed during a pain episode. Doctors say severe period pain that disrupts daily life is not normal, and endometriosis often goes undiagnosed for years.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Endometriosis and its years-long diagnostic delays affect women everywhere, making awareness of the warning signs relevant for diaspora readers too.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Baba Ramdev's 'Ayurvedic Hookah' Ignites Memes, Mockery and a Medical Warning
lifestyle-health.excerpt: A viral video shows the yoga guru loading a hookah with herbs and claiming it balances the doshas. Doctors say inhaling any smoke is no therapy.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Yoga guru Baba Ramdev in a still from the viral Instagram video showing his so-called ayurvedic hookah. Medical experts say inhaling any smoke is not a safe therapy for cough or congestion, despite the herbal ingredients.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Ramdev's Patanjali products have a large diaspora following; diaspora families navigating Ayurveda-meets-wellness-trend claims need clear medical context on what's tradition and what's marketing.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Could Your Daily Coffee Habit Actually Slow Down Aging?
lifestyle-health.excerpt: From protective brain receptors to large-scale mortality studies, researchers find moderate coffee drinking is linked with healthier aging — but the evidence comes with important caveats.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A cup of coffee. Large observational studies link two to three cups a day with lower risks of early death, though researchers stress the findings show association, not causation.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: India's diaspora is swapping filter kaapi for espresso culture — the research's two-to-three-cup sweet spot, with decaf as a viable option, fits both traditions.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Ozempic and Wegovy May Carry a Hair-Loss Risk for Some Men
lifestyle-health.excerpt: A new NYU Langone study finds the first genetic link between GLP-1 drugs and male-pattern hair loss — but researchers stress the evidence is early and applies only to men already genetically predisposed.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Ozempic injection pens. An NYU Langone Health study found men genetically predisposed to pattern baldness face roughly 7 percent higher odds of hair loss with GLP-1 drugs.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: GLP-1 medications are widely used by Indian-American patients managing diabetes and obesity; those noticing unusual shedding should raise it with their doctor rather than abandoning a treatment whose metabolic benefits are well established.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: A Third of Americans May Have Fatty Liver Disease — Diet Is the Fix
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Up to 42% of American adults may have fat building up in their livers without knowing it. Doctors say the fix isn't a cleanse — it's what you eat every day.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease. Between 30 and 40 percent of American adults have excess fat stored in their livers, and gastroenterologists say diet is the first-line treatment.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: For Indian-American households, where rich festive foods and sedentary workdays are common — and where metabolic disease strikes at lower body weights — the hepatologists' dietary advice is directly relevant family-health guidance.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

food.image_caption: Chef Nar Singh poses for a photograph. Bhog Indian Restaurant in Somerset, New Jersey, has named him its new assistant sous chef.
food.nri_angle: Chefs trained in India's luxury hotel kitchens increasingly anchor the U.S. Indian restaurant scene, and this hire reflects the continued professionalisation of New Jersey's Indian dining market.

food.excerpt: A Hyderabad diner's side-by-side comparison — Rs 230 at Panchakattu Dosa versus Rs 436 on Swiggy for the same meal — has reignited debate over platform fees and inflated menu prices.
food.image_caption: A side-by-side of the Panchakattu Dosa restaurant receipt and the same items in the Swiggy app cart. The same three dishes cost Rs 230 in person and Rs 436 on Swiggy.
food.nri_angle: NRIs ordering for family in India hit the same gap — a modest local meal nearly doubles on the app, mirroring the platform-fee economics they know from DoorDash and Uber Eats.

food.excerpt: The two-Michelin-starred London institution from JKS Restaurants has opened its first UAE outpost in DIFC's Gate Village, pairing Mayfair signatures with its largest set of location-exclusive dishes yet.

food.title: India's food prices set to rise further as El Niño weakens monsoon, economists warn
food.excerpt: With August retail inflation at a 20-month high of 4.82% and the monsoon deficit the worst since FY16, economists warn food-price pressures could keep inflation above 5% and force the RBI's hand.
food.image_caption: Wheat being harvested in Punjab, India. Erratic monsoon and El Niño conditions are pushing food prices higher, with retail inflation hitting a 20-month high in August.
food.nri_angle: Rising food prices hit diaspora families supporting relatives in India, and RBI rate moves shape the rupee and Indian markets that NRI investors watch.

food.title: Very Hot Beverages Linked To Triple Esophageal Cancer Risk, Major Study Finds
food.excerpt: A study of nearly a million UK adults found those who prefer drinks 'very hot' face more than triple the risk of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma — but researchers stress it's the heat, not the chai, that matters.
food.image_caption: Two steaming mugs of a hot beverage. A study of nearly a million UK adults found that preferring drinks 'very hot' more than triples the risk of esophageal cancer.
food.nri_angle: Indian households serve chai boiling and order it 'kadak,' but the science says the drink is innocent and the scalding is not — diaspora chai drinkers can keep the ritual and simply let the cup cool a few minutes.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Paneer Lababdar, Millet Pulao and Mulberry Phirni: What BRICS Leaders Ate at Modi's Gala Dinner
food.excerpt: A ten-course vegetarian banquet at Bharat Mandapam took world leaders from Gujarati khandvi to Himalayan morels to mulberry-topped phirni — with millets front and centre.
food.image_caption: BRICS leaders, including Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Russian President Vladimir Putin, seated at the gala dinner at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi. The menu highlighted millet-based dishes and regional Indian ingredients, including paneer lababdar and mulberry phirni.
food.nri_angle: The gala dinner menu showcases regional Indian cuisine on the world stage, a point of cultural pride for the diaspora, and continues India's millet diplomacy that diaspora food writers have been tracking since 2023.

food.title: 'Healthy' Snacks May Not Be: What a Nutritionist Says About Millet Chips, Ragi Cookies and Makhana
food.excerpt: Nutritionist Lakshmi Kale tells Hindustan Times' 'Indian Food Decoded' that processing, oil and salt can undo the benefits of millet, ragi and vegetable ingredients in packaged snacks.
food.image_caption: A bowl of Indian namkeen mixture at a snack shop. Nutritionist Lakshmi Kale says millet chips, ragi cookies and makhana should be judged as finished products rather than by a single wholesome ingredient on the label.
food.nri_angle: Indian grocery stores and mainstream supermarkets alike are full of millet chips and makhana marketed to health-conscious Indian families — the same label-reading discipline applies wherever you shop.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Sanjeev Kapoor's Pineapple Sheera: A Step-by-Step Guide to the Festive Dessert
food.excerpt: The celebrity chef's fruity take on the classic semolina dessert combines roasted rawa, ghee and fresh pineapple — a simple, festive sweet that takes about an hour.
food.image_caption: Pineapple sheera served in a bowl, garnished with nuts. Celebrity chef Sanjeev Kapoor shared the recipe for the festive semolina dessert ahead of the festival season.
food.nri_angle: A classic Indian dessert many in the diaspora grew up with gets a fresh twist — an easy, familiar recipe for festive gatherings abroad, using ingredients available in any Indian grocery store.

food.title: Zomato Starts Charging Up to Rs 20 on Cash-on-Delivery Orders
food.excerpt: The 'pay on delivery fee' appears as a separate line in the bill summary on cash orders, on top of platform fees, packaging charges and GST — while online payments remain exempt.
food.image_caption: A Zomato app bill summary shows the new "Pay on delivery fee" of Rs 5 on a cash-on-delivery order. The fee, which can range up to Rs 20, began appearing on orders from September 12.
food.nri_angle: NRIs ordering food for family back in India — and anyone watching India's delivery duopoly — now see another line item on the bill, with cash-paying customers bearing the cost.

food.title: Table for One: Are Indian Restaurants Ready for the Solo Diner?
food.excerpt: A quiet cultural shift is emptying the stigma from eating alone in India, as restaurants redesign seating, menus, and service for guests of one.
food.image_caption: A person eats alone at a restaurant table. Solo dining is on the rise in urban India, and restaurants are redesigning their spaces for parties of one.
food.nri_angle: The solo-dining wave mirrors what Indian buffet restaurants in the US already see, and it changes what NRIs visiting India can expect: the corner table is no longer the loneliest seat in the house.

travel.title: Air India to Launch India's First UATP Corporate Travel Payment Program
travel.excerpt: The Tata-owned carrier will let companies and travel agencies buy tickets through a single centralized UATP account instead of juggling cards and payment methods for every traveler.
travel.image_caption: A person holds a smartphone and a payment card, with digital network icons overlaid. Air India plans to launch India first UATP corporate travel payment program for businesses and travel agencies.
travel.nri_angle: Indian businesses and NRI professionals who book Air India through corporate programs or travel agencies will see tickets settle through a single account, reducing expense friction and opening access to negotiated corporate fares.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Three Italians Skip Delhi Immigration, Fly to Munich; Air India Gets Notice
travel.excerpt: The passengers landed at Delhi airport at 12:50 am on September 4 and boarded a Lufthansa flight 55 minutes later without immigration checks, prompting a show-cause notice and an emergency Home Ministry meeting.
travel.image_caption: An Air India aircraft. Three Italian passengers skipped Delhi immigration and flew to Munich, drawing a notice for Air India.
travel.nri_angle: The Amritsar-Delhi route is a lifeline for the Punjabi diaspora, and this lapse could mean tighter checks for every transit passenger connecting through Delhi.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Diwali flight fares soar: Delhi-Patna hits ₹12,500 as demand spikes
travel.excerpt: Regional routes are seeing fares triple ahead of the November 8 festival, with Kolkata-Deoghar up 340 percent and last-minute Delhi-Patna tickets crossing ₹13,500. The DGCA has asked airlines to add over 1,760 flights to check the surge.
travel.image_caption: An Air India Airbus A320neo comes in to land with its gear down. Domestic fares on regional routes have tripled ahead of the Diwali 2026 weekend, with Delhi-Patna crossing ₹12,500.
travel.nri_angle: NRIs flying home for Diwali should lock in domestic connecting tickets now — the domestic leg is usually booked last and sells at peak festive fares, and train connections may be far cheaper on thin regional routes.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Railways Adds 400 Special Train Trips as Diwali-Chhath Demand Overwhelms IRCTC
travel.excerpt: Passengers saw 'high load' and 'regret' within minutes of booking windows opening for mid-November journeys; East Central Railway's 16 festival specials run September 16 to November 30.
travel.image_caption: An Indian Railways locomotive alongside devotees gathered for Chhath Puja at a river ghat. The Railways has approved around 400 special train trips to Bihar for the Diwali and Chhath festival rush.
travel.nri_angle: NRIs connecting from international flights to Bihar or eastern UP for the festivals should book domestic rail legs early and check special trains, not just regular services already running waitlists of 100-200.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Air India Warns of Flight Disruptions as UK Air Traffic Fault Grounds 2,000 Flights
travel.excerpt: A technical failure at Britain's air traffic control provider NATS forced more than 1,750 flight cancellations on Tuesday, leaving over 330,000 passengers stranded. Air India advised travellers to check flight status before heading to the airport.
travel.image_caption: Delayed passengers queue with their luggage at Heathrow airport in west London on Tuesday. More than 1,750 flights were cancelled after a technical fault at Britain’s air traffic control provider NATS disrupted operations.
travel.nri_angle: Air India's UK routes connect London Heathrow and Birmingham with Delhi, Mumbai and Bengaluru — one of the busiest diaspora corridors — so the outage hits students, families and festive-season bookings directly; passengers should check flight status before heading to the airport and know their rebooking and duty-of-care rights under UK rules.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Air India CEO Summoned Over Immigration Lapse as Leadership Arrives at Bombay House
carousel.excerpt: The Centre has summoned Air India chief Tewolde Gebremariam over the departure of three Italian nationals from Delhi without immigration clearance, as he and predecessor Campbell Wilson arrived together at Bombay House in Mumbai.
carousel.image_caption: Air India CEO and MD Tewolde Gebremariam at Bombay House, the Tata Group headquarters, in Mumbai. He arrived there on September 15 with predecessor Campbell Wilson as the Centre summoned the airline chief over an alleged immigration lapse at Delhi airport.
carousel.nri_angle: Diaspora travelers transiting through Delhi on domestic-to-international connections — the most common itinerary for Indians flying home — should verify immigration and transfer channels themselves, since this lapse shows a boarding pass and checked-through bag don't guarantee formalities were completed.

carousel.title: Air India Board Convenes in Mumbai as New CEO Gebremariam Prepares to Take Charge
carousel.excerpt: Directors led by N. Chandrasekaran met at Bombay House to set the pay package for incoming chief Tewolde Gebremariam and formalize the handover from outgoing CEO Campbell Wilson.
carousel.image_caption: Incoming Air India CEO Tewolde Gebremariam (left) and outgoing CEO Campbell Wilson (right). The Air India board met in Mumbai to discuss Gebremariam pay package as he prepares to take charge.

carousel.title: Nafisa Ali Shares Health Update as She Begins Targeted Therapy
carousel.excerpt: The veteran actress told followers on Instagram that a PET/CT scan showed new deposits on her liver, and that her medical team has moved her onto targeted therapy.
carousel.image_caption: Nafisa Ali smiles at an event, wearing a red saree with a decorative blue border and gold jewelry. The veteran Bollywood actress has shared that her Stage 4 cancer has progressed and she is beginning targeted therapy.
carousel.nri_angle: For many in the Indian diaspora facing cancer in their own families, Ali's plain-spoken public updates have become a touchstone — a well-known face describing scans, protocols and setbacks in language other patients recognize.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Cruise Ships and Container Huts: Asian Games 2026 Faces Bed Crunch Before Liftoff
carousel.excerpt: With 17,000 athletes and officials descending on Nagoya and Aichi — more than the Olympics — organizers have scrapped the athletes' village for a cruise liner, hotels and wooden containers, and not everyone is sleeping easy.
carousel.image_caption: Replica container accommodation built by the Sports Authority of India. Indian athletes are spending nights in the units to acclimatize before the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games.
carousel.nri_angle: Diaspora fans get a record-sized Indian contingent and the tantalizing prospect of an India-Pakistan cricket final on a global stage.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Air India Deepens Salesforce AI Bet to Speed Up Customer Service
carousel.excerpt: Air India is expanding its deployment of Salesforce's Agentforce agentic AI across customer service, automating complex email requests, cutting name corrections from days to 30 minutes, and giving agents a conversational knowledge assistant.
carousel.image_caption: A person taps a smiley-face satisfaction rating on a tablet, a familiar customer feedback interface for airlines. Air India has expanded its deployment of Salesforce’s Agentforce AI platform to automate customer service workflows spanning refunds, baggage and name corrections.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian diaspora flyers on long-haul US-UK-Canada-Gulf routes are Air India's heaviest international users, and the AI-automated name corrections and multi-request email resolution target exactly the booking and refund pain points they hit most often.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Paytm Shares Slide as NPCI Confirms 0.4% UPI Fee Above Rs 2,000
carousel.excerpt: India's payments authority will levy the first-ever merchant fee on high-value UPI transactions from October 15, a day after the government shielded smaller payments from charges — and investors are repricing Paytm's earnings power.
carousel.image_caption: A Paytm-branded markets graphic from The Economic Times. Paytm parent One 97 Communications fell more than 2.5% on Tuesday after the NPCI announced a 0.4% UPI fee on merchant payments above Rs 2,000.
carousel.nri_angle: NRIs who use UPI during India visits and diaspora investors in Indian fintech will feel the pricing and valuation shifts as the fee regime takes effect.
